instruction.text: Listen to the text and drag full stops to the correct places.

trainers.hint: We use a full stop to mark the end of a sentence. At the end of a sentence we take a pause.

atoms.sound: ssml: Tom wants to have breakfast. <break time='1000ms'/>He decides to make some toast.<break time='1000ms'/> Now Tom is not as hungry.

atoms.sound: ssml: Amy had to go grocery shopping. <break time='1000ms'/>She bought all of her favourite vegetables.<break time='1000ms'/> She is planning to cook a stew.
atoms.b: Amy had to go grocery shopping ((.)) She bought all of her favourite vegetables ((.)) She is planning to cook a stew ((.))

trainers.instruction: Use all the words to form a sentence with a question mark.
trainers.hint: A question mark is used at the end of a sentence to indicate a direct question.

trainers.instruction: Which sentences end with an exclamation mark? Connect them to the exclamation mark.
trainers.hint: An exclamation mark is used to express strong emotion or emphasis at the end of a sentence.
